item.title: Kitsap County man arrested in Agnew after standoff
item.description: Clallam County Sheriff’s Office reports two men were arrested on Wednesday night with one man in a standoff for several hours after hiding in an attic.

item.title: Borrow This Book: “Writing Mr. Wrong” by Kelley Armstrong
City hires new economic development director
item.description: The City of Sequim has announced the hiring of Karla Boughton as community and economic development director. She started in the role last month after having served as interim director since last October.

item.title: Quality Inn honored for employing, supporting disabled
item.description: Quality Inn and Suites at Olympic National Park, 134 River Road in Sequim, was recently recognized by Morningside Services for its continued support of an employee with a disability.

item.title: Festival issues ‘trash’ fashion challenge
item.description: Sequim Irrigation Festival held its first Trashion Challenge on March 7 at Studio Bob in Port Angeles leading up to its Trashion Show on May 2 in the Guy Cole Event Center in Sequim.

item.title: Washington can’t afford to wait on data center regulations
item.description: Big Tech’s artificial intelligence data centers are ballooning across the country, including along the Columbia River.
